notes:
**What's missing:** The question says "football" without saying which one. No `place` was given, so I can't tell whether they mean soccer or American football. Both are covered below. "GOAT" is an opinion, not a checked fact, so these notes record who the sources name.

**Soccer (as of mid-October 2026)**
- Most recent coverage names Lionel Messi. The Globe and Mail ran an opinion piece on July 6, 2026 saying Ronaldo's World Cup exit settles the GOAT debate. It names Messi and points to his World Cup trophy as the proof.
- The trigger was Portugal's exit. Portugal lost to Spain in the 2026 World Cup round of 16.
- Other outlets agree. A Yahoo Sports comparison piece concludes: "Lionel Messi." Squawka also concludes Messi is the greatest.
- Squawka's career table (published about May 2026) shows what each player leads in:
  - Messi has 8 Ballon d'Or wins to Ronaldo's 5.
  - Ronaldo has more career goals, 970 to 906, and more international goals, 143 to 109.
  - Messi has more career assists, 408 to 261.
- A Korea Times piece from July 2026 says momentum has shifted toward Messi after the 2022 and 2026 World Cups.
- The sources I found are all media opinion pieces, and they lean toward Messi. Ronaldo is still widely regarded as one of the greatest. Jamie Carragher has called him one of the greatest goalscorers of all time. The Carragher quote is from an older article (about 2023), not 2026.
- The results did not show who won the 2026 World Cup. Another source says Messi's trophy is the 2022 World Cup. I can't say anything about the 2026 final.

**American football (NFL)**
- Tom Brady is the most common answer. A CBS Sports top-25 all-time NFL list by Bryan DeArdo put Brady first. That list is from about mid-2025, based on the article's age.
- Brady won seven Super Bowls, which is the basis of his case.
- Brady himself has named someone else. In early 2026 he said "Jerry Rice is still the GOAT." That is from a documentary appearance reported in February 2026.
- Patrick Mahomes is the main challenger. A Pro Football Network piece dated September 28, 2026 says fans remain divided on how his career compares with Brady's.
- Brady's seven rings remain the benchmark. He is still ahead of Mahomes on Super Bowl titles. That is from an older article (about February 2025).
- Brady also said in June 2026 that "there's no greater passer of the football than Aaron Rodgers." That is a comment on passing, not a GOAT pick.
